project: 4_SMM_Pack / SMM_pack.aep (Collect Files copy of the original 'Заставка_shorts.aep', collected 01.12.2025)
summary: SMM_pack.aep is a 7.5 MB project saved by AE 25.x with the legacy ExtendScript expression engine. It has 21 comps, 10 footage items, 397 expressions and one font (SB Sans Display Semibold), and no Essential Graphics anywhere. It holds Cloud.ru social graphics for square (1440x1440) and vertical (1080x1920): a shorts intro (Заставка_9x16), 2-line caption plashki with a phrase switch (Плашки_1x1/9x16), a looping notched frame overlay (Оверлей_1x1/9x16), two transparent background patterns in two formats each (an arrow grid that shrinks around a wandering focus point, and a twinkling plus-grid), and a 21-frame bar wipe-through transition in gray, green and white plus a logo version. Nearly everything is hand-keyed shape and text layers. Bar widths are typed numbers, variants are duplicate comps that differ only in fill colour, scale, time-stretch or renderer, and frame rates are mixed (25 fps for BG, overlay and plashki; 24 fps for intro, transitions and logo) while the team's SMM AME presets and the brand tokens are 30 fps. The only parametric rig is PATTERN_EDIT (390 precomp cells, each running a distance-to-null scale expression driven by 4 sliders and a wiggling null); it should stay a prerender. 10 of the 13 deliverable comps were rendered to ProRes 4444 with alpha (2.14 GB total). Those renders carry a silent PCM track, are 30/60 s non-seamless 'loops', and the transitions are stamped TC 00:00:03:04. Plashki and the intro were never rendered. Footage links are clean: the stored Mac paths resolve relatively to (Footage)/Folder/… next to the .aep.

templates.purpose: 2-line SMM caption (плашка). Dark bars grow from the left edge, lime words rise inside them, phrase A is swapped for phrase B mid-clip (bars re-width), then everything collapses.
templates.build_notes:
No precomps.

Bars: 'Shape Layer 3' (upper, y=1155) and 'Shape Layer 4' (lower, y=1264); in 9x16 they are 'Shape Layer 7'/'Shape Layer 6'. Each is a Rectangle 1231x110, #222222, with the anchor moved to the left edge (-720), so Scale X grows to the right; bars overlap by 1 px. Each bar has 6 Scale keys:
- grow 0→102.1% in 22 f
- re-width 102.1→101.7% in 20 f at the phrase switch
- collapse to 0 in 20 f
- the lower bar starts 10 f before the upper one.

Text: 4 layers, SB Sans Display Semibold 100 px, leading 89, tracking -50, fill #CFF500.
- Phrase A: 'Разверните свой личный' / ' блог на Word Press'.
- Phrase B: 'На виртуальной машине' / ' Cloud.ru Evolution'.
- The second line of each phrase is its own layer whose text starts with a CR, i.e. an empty first line used to push it one line down.
- Each text layer is ALPHA-matted to its bar with an AE 23+ layer-reference matte (non-adjacent).
- Animator 1: Position (0,100), Range Selector Based On Words. In: Start 0→100% over 20 f. Out: End 100→0% over 11 f.

Plashki_9x16 is the 1x1 rig scaled down, not re-laid out: text Scale 75%, bar Y-scale 75%, X re-keyed to 0.7448/0.7628 and 0.621/0.5887. Its bars start 28 px from the edge instead of bleeding, its copy and timing differ (switch at 5.2–6.4 s), and it uses the Advanced 3D renderer (1x1 uses Classic 3D).

Hard to parametrize because widths are typed per phrase, the line break is faked, and phrase timing lives in 24 independent keyframes.

problems.detail: Plashki bar widths are hand-keyed per phrase (Shape Layer 3/4 Scale X 1.021→1.017 in Плашки_1x1; Shape Layer 7/6 0.7448→0.7628 and 0.621→0.5887 in Плашки_9x16). Every text layer is ALPHA-matted to its bar, so any longer copy is silently clipped and any shorter copy leaves an empty bar tail. The template cannot be reused without re-keying.
problems.fix: Drive Rect Size from TXT.sourceRectAtTime() (sampled at rest, per ae-motion-live quirk 86) plus padding. Keep Scale X only as a 0→100% reveal multiplier with the existing curve.

problems.detail:
Three frame rates in one SMM pack:
- 25 fps: BG_pattern_*, Плашки_*, Оверлей_*, PATTERN_EDIT, Pattern_edit, +, Shape Layer 2/5 Comp 1.
- 24 fps: Заставка_9x16, the 4 Transition comps, both logo comps, Pattern_strelki.
The team's SMM_1x1/9x16/16x9/1440x1080 .epr presets are 30 fps (preset names '…_30fps', 8467200000 ticks/frame), and the ae-motion-live tokens set story/square to 30 fps. 24/25 fps prerenders judder in 30 fps edits, and a 21 f @24 transition cannot be frame-exact at 30.
problems.fix: Pick one master fps (likely 30) and retime every template in frames. Prefer mogrt (sampled at the sequence rate) over prerender; re-render the prerenders at the master fps.

problems.detail: The Advanced 3D renderer (ADBE Calder) is set on BG_pattern_1x1_1, BG_pattern_1x1_2, Плашки_9x16, Оверлей_1x1 and Shape Layer 5 Comp 1, although none of them has a 3D layer. Their siblings (BG_pattern_9x16_*, Плашки_1x1, Оверлей_9x16) use Classic 3D. It adds a GPU/renderer dependency and is a MOGRT compatibility risk with no visual benefit.
problems.fix: Switch all 5 comps to Classic 3D before building templates.

problems.detail: No Essential Graphics anywhere: all 21 CIFO/CIF2/CIF3 capsules are 'Untitled' with no controllers. The only controls in the whole pack are the 4 sliders on PATTERN_EDIT 'Adjustment Layer 1'. Nothing can be exported as a MOGRT or driven by a panel as-is.
problems.fix: Add a CTRL layer plus Essential Properties per template (text fields, colour dropdowns, checkboxes, media replacement). Script EGP and MOGRT export with Property.addToMotionGraphicsTemplateAs and CompItem.exportAsMotionGraphicsTemplate; verify these on AE 2025/2026 — they contradict the vault note that MOGRT export via ExtendScript is impossible.

problems.detail: All 13 text layers use SB Sans Display Semibold, a corporate font that is not on Adobe Fonts. A MOGRT opened on a machine without it substitutes the font, and Pr can only auto-sync Adobe Fonts. ae-motion-live quirk 187: the PostScript name must be 'SBSansDisplay-Semibold'; the other spelling renders in Times with no warning.
problems.fix: Plugin checks fonts on start (and at install). Ship or install the font if the licence allows, otherwise block MOGRT insertion with a clear message. Stills can use outlined text.

problems.detail:
The project uses the legacy ExtendScript expression engine with 397 expressions:
- 390 identical proximity-scale expressions in PATTERN_EDIT, each reading 4 sliders and a null every frame
- wiggle(0.3,1000)
- 2× time*50
- effect("Fractal Noise")(28)
- 2× loopOut()
- transform.scale (a no-op).
None uses engine-specific syntax, so all are JavaScript-engine compatible, but the 390-layer rig is far too heavy for a MOGRT or interactive Pr playback.
problems.fix: File > Project Settings > Expressions: JavaScript. Keep PATTERN_EDIT as a prerender. Delete the no-op and index-based expressions.

problems.detail:
Near-duplicate comps and variants:
- Transition_green and Transition_white = Transition_gray with only the 10 fill colours changed.
- Cloud.ru_BlackMono 3 is identical to Cloud.ru_BlackMono.
- Shape Layer 5 Comp 1 = Shape Layer 2 Comp 1 time-stretched 149.4%, with Advanced 3D.
- Плашки_9x16 = Плашки_1x1 scaled 75%, with new copy and timing.
- BG 1x1 and 9x16 crop the same 3840x2160 PATTERN_EDIT at 100% and 125%.
- BG_pattern_1x1_2's noise matte is at 50% opacity, BG_pattern_9x16_2's at 100%.
problems.fix: One master rig per template family. Variants come from controls (colour dropdowns, logo checkbox) and per-format comp sizes with layout expressions, never from copies.

problems.detail:
Line breaks are faked by hand:
- Заставка_9x16 title is 4 hand-split text layers, each with its own static mask, plus a hidden full-text layer.
- In Плашки, each phrase's second line is a separate layer whose text starts with a CR (an empty first line) to drop it one line down.
Editing the copy means retyping several layers and re-fitting masks.
problems.fix: Use explicit line fields (TXT_L1..L4 / TXT_A1, A2, B1, B2) that auto-stack, skip empty lines, and get matte rectangles from sourceRectAtTime. Remove the CR hack and the hidden copy.

problems.detail:
Prerenders and loops are not seamless:
- BG_pattern_*_1: first vs last frame mean max-channel difference ≈13–14/255 (wiggle is not periodic).
- BG_pattern_*_2: ≈0.7/255 (Evolution time*50 = 1500° per 30 s).
- Overlay: loop period 14.96 s on a 15 s source (and 22.36 s on the 1x1), so a frame repeats at each seam.
problems.fix: Use a loopable wiggle (blend wiggle(t) and wiggle(t-L)), Evolution = time*360*N/L with Cycle Evolution on, and loop periods of an exact whole number of frames. Deliver 10–15 s loops; the plugin repeats them to fill the selection.

problems.detail: All 10 renders are ProRes 4444 (yuva444p12le) with a silent pcm_s16le stereo track (1.5 Mb/s) and a tmcd track. Transitions start at TC 00:00:03:04 (comp display start 3.1667 s). BGs run 30 s at 100–137 Mb/s (377–513 MB each) and overlays 60 s for a 15–22 s cycle; total ≈2.14 GB. Плашки_* and Заставка_9x16 were never rendered.
problems.fix: Re-render video-only with TC 00:00:00:00 and 10–15 s seamless loops. Add an ame-preset 'CR_ProRes4444_Alpha_NoAudio_<fps>'. Offer opaque H.264/HEVC versions baked on #222222 if alpha is not needed.

problems.detail: Render/Overlay/Оверлей_1x1.mov and Оверлей_9x16.mov are stored in Mac NFD form ('й' = и + U+0306). They look identical in Explorer but fail string or path matching against NFC names on Windows. The contact sheets inherit the same problem.
problems.fix: Rename deliverables to ASCII/NFC (e.g. smm_overlay_frame_1x1.mov). Normalise every path to NFC in the plugin manifest and loader.

problems.detail: Hidden layer time-stretch: Transition_1/Transition_2 in all 3 transition comps run at 262.5% (keys span 8 source frames stretched over 21), and 'Shape Layer 5' runs at 149.4%. Duration edits and Responsive Time behave unpredictably.
problems.fix: Bake the stretch to 100% with keys at real times (f0/f20 @24, i.e. ≈f0/f25 @30).

problems.detail:
Invisible or hidden content:
- In Заставка_9x16, Pattern_strelki (L9) sits under the opaque AI video (L8) inside the same Green_cube_2 alpha matte. All blend modes decode as Normal, so it is never visible, yet it renders a 6539x5598 PNG plus Fractal Noise every frame.
- Hidden layers: Pattern_strelki L3 (CC Threshold RGB + CC Vignette); Pattern_edit 'pattern_1', '+', 'Cube'; PATTERN_EDIT 'Cube' (debug marker parented to the null) and 'Background'; the Заставка full-text layer.
problems.fix: Delete them, or turn the alternates into a 'Glyph' dropdown. Either move the pattern above the video with Multiply or drop it (confirm the intent).

problems.detail: Заставка_9x16 lasts 5.0 s, but content ends at 3.54 s and the wipe at 4.04 s, so f97–f120 are empty. The transition comps keep a display start of 3.1667 s from being cut out of the intro.
problems.fix: Trim to the end of the wipe and reset display start to 0.

problems.detail:
Names are generic or misleading:
- Generic: 'Shape Layer 3/4/6/7', 'Shape Layer 2 Comp 1', 'Shape Layer 5 Comp 1', bin 'Folder', layers '+ 2'/'+ 3'.
- Misleading: 'Green_cube_2' is a WHITE card used as a matte; 'Cloud.ru_BlackMono' is the white+green logo; 'Dark Gray Solid 3/5/6' are #222222; the arrow PNG 'Rectangle 34627972.png' sits in Folder/Solids.
- Whitespace: layer names with leading or trailing spaces (' Cloud.ru Evolution', 'Как быстро создать ').
- Fragile: the 390 expressions find layers by source names ('Null 1', 'Adjustment Layer 1'), so renaming the solids breaks them.
problems.fix: Adopt a convention (CTRL_, TXT_, BAR_, CARD_, MATTE_, BG_, SRC_), give every layer an explicit name, use ASCII comp IDs with Russian display names, and update the expressions when renaming.

problems.detail: Pattern_strelki 'Mask' Random Seed carries the expression effect("Fractal Noise")(28). It references param index 28, the end marker of the Evolution Options group, so it is either a no-op or overrides the 0→24 seed keys. 'Strelka' Scale has a no-op 'transform.scale'.
problems.fix: Remove both. Drive the seed with Math.floor(time*fps/step) and confirm visually in AE that the dissolve animates.

problems.detail:
Layout varies by format for no clear reason:
- The 9x16 overlay is the frame shape non-uniformly scaled 70% x 130%, so bar thickness differs between horizontal and vertical edges.
- Rects 1/2/3/5 carry 3 identical keys each.
- BG cell size is 150 px in 1x1 but 187.5 px in 9x16.
- Plashki bleed from the edge in 1x1 but start 28 px in on 9x16.
- The logo is 80% in the intro and 100% in Transition with Logo.
problems.fix: Use layout expressions keyed on thisComp.width/height plus a single size control per element.

problems.detail:
Housekeeping issues:
- Long durations: precomp '+' is 401.92 s, Pattern_edit 300 s, and cell layers run 300 s inside 30 s comps.
- BG_pattern_9x16_1/2, '+' and Pattern_edit were saved at Quarter preview resolution.
- 3D switches are on for 2D elements (Transition_1/2, the Pattern_strelki PNG layers).
- The AI video layer has Rotate -90° and Z-scale 134%.
problems.fix: Trim durations to the loop length, set Full resolution, turn off the 3D switches, and reset the transforms.

problems.detail:
The file was saved by AE 25.x and uses AE 23+ layer-reference track mattes, which are non-adjacent:
- Заставка L8/L9 matte to L10.
- Each Plashki text layer mattes to a bar 2–4 layers away.
Once saved in AE 2026 it will not open in AE 2025, and MOGRTs need a recent Pr.
problems.fix: Pick the oldest AE/Pr version to support and author templates in it. Note the minimum version in the plugin manifest.

problems.detail:
The pack's curves and colours deviate from the ae-motion-live tokens:
- Plashki use #CFF500 text on #222222 bars with no green; the tokens treat yellow as a secondary accent always paired with green.
- Title lines rise with an almost linear curve (influence ≈12%/10%) instead of the tokens' 'enter' ease [16,70].
- CC Vignette, forbidden by the tokens, sits on a hidden layer.
- Near-white values #FEFEFE/#FBFBFB are used instead of #FFFFFF/#F2F2F2.
problems.fix: Decide whether the pack's own curves or the tokens are canonical for SMM. Normalise the whites.

problems.detail: AME has SMM_16x9 (1920x1080) and SMM_1440x1080 presets, but the pack has only 1x1 and 9x16 comps. The 1x1 comps are 1440x1440 while the SMM_1x1 export is 1080x1080.
problems.fix: Decide which formats the templates must cover (see questions). Build MOGRT comps at delivery size.

problems.detail:
Gaps in the shared audit data for this pack:
- scratchpad/aep_audit.py reports 'effects: {}' for SMM because effect instances stored under LIST sspc are not counted. Actual effects: Fractal Noise ×3, CC RepeTile ×2, CC Threshold RGB + CC Vignette ×1 (hidden), Fill ×2, Slider ×4.
- frames/4_SMM_Pack__(Footage)__…kling…mp4.png is blank grey (a direct ffmpeg grab shows a white security-camera 'orb' on light grey).
problems.fix: Use the decoders in C:\dev\temp\claude\C--Users------Documents-Cloud-ru-Preset-plugin\b48e0614-1141-4125-9b74-d00eb767441b\scratchpad\work\: smm_keys.py (keyframes, static values, layer flags, mattes, parent, stretch, renderer) and smm_dump.py. ldta offsets: stretch num @8 / den @108, start @12/16, in @20/24, out @28/32, flags @37–39 (video bit0, MB 0x08, 3D 0x04@38, ADJ 0x02@38), blend mode @96 (2 = Normal), matte mode @104, parent id @132, layer type @128, matte layer id @160. Key times = layer start + stored time.

questions_for_user: What is the master frame rate for SMM: 30 fps (your SMM_*.epr presets and the brand tokens) or 25 fps (most of the pack)? Were the 24 fps intro and transitions deliberate?
Which SMM formats must the templates cover: only 1x1 and 9x16, or also 16x9 and 4:3 (1440x1080) as in AME? Should the square master be 1080 (matching the export preset) or 1440 (as in the pack)?

Plashki colours: keep lime #CFF500 on #222222 bars as the canonical SMM style? Which alternatives should be allowed, e.g. green bar with #222222 text or white bar with #222222 text? The brand tokens pair yellow only with green.

Transitions: which logo colourway goes on white and green bars (the current logo is a white wordmark)? Should the transition button also drop an SFX cue, e.g. '02 Simple Whoosh B.wav' from the podcast pack?
Will only you use these MOGRTs/presets, or other editors/contractors too? Can the plugin installer ship or install SB Sans Display, or must templates degrade gracefully without it?
Which oldest AE/Pr versions must the templates open in? The file is from AE 25.x; templates authored in AE 2026 will not open in AE 2025.

Заставка_9x16: should it become a generic FAQ-shorts intro (title + any media)? Is the arrow-pattern dissolve meant to be visible? It is currently hidden under the AI video. Is the -90° rotation of the AI video intentional?
BG patterns: deliver with alpha only, or also baked on #222222/#F2F2F2 as small opaque loops? What loop length is enough (10 s / 15 s / 30 s)?
Overlay frame: is it meant to frame the entire video or only segments? Are green/white versions needed besides #222222?

animation_patterns.name: Plashka grow / re-width / collapse (Scale X from left edge)
animation_patterns.description:
Shape Scale X with the anchor on the bar's left edge (-720).
- Grow 0→~102% over 22 f @25 (0.88 s): out-influence 86.65%, in 79.61%, ≈ cubic-bezier(0.87,0,0.20,1), essentially the brand 'wipe' ease.
- Re-width to the new phrase over 20 f (55.4%→84.2%).
- Collapse to 0 over 20 f (92%→84%).
- The lower bar leads the upper one by 10 f; bars overlap by 1 px.
At 30 fps: 26 f / 24 f / 24 f, 12 f stagger.

animation_patterns.name: Word rise inside the bar (in) / reverse word drop (out)
animation_patterns.description:
Text Animator Position (0,+100 px) with Range Selector Based On Words.
- In: Start 0→100% over 20 f @25. Key 1 out-influence 100%, key 2 in-influence 33%, ≈ cubic-bezier(1,0,0.67,1).
- Out: End 100→0% over 11 f, out-influence 33% then in-influence 100%, ≈ (0.33,0,0,1), so the last word drops first.
- Text is alpha-matted to its bar, so words appear from inside it.
- Line stagger 10 f; holds 1.3–3.2 s.
At 30 fps: 24 f in / 13 f out / 12 f stagger.
where_used: Плашки_1x1: 'Разверните свой личный', ' блог на Word Press', 'На виртуальной машине', ' Cloud.ru Evolution'

animation_patterns.name: Masked title line rise
animation_patterns.description: Each line is its own text layer with a static line-sized mask. Animator Position (0,+252 px) Based On Lines; Start 0→100% over 23 f @24 (0.96 s). The curve is near-linear: out-influence 11.9%, in 10.3%, ≈ (0.12,0,0.90,1). Line starts at 0/2/4/6 f (83 ms stagger). At 30 fps: ≈29 f, 3 f stagger (matches the tokens' word stagger).

animation_patterns.name: Bar wipe-through transition
animation_patterns.description: Two shape layers of 5 stepped rectangles each, moving in opposite directions: upper x 2130→-1162 px, lower x -1476→2241 px. Two LINEAR Position keys at f0 and f20 @24, motion blur on, total 21 f. Full-frame cover ≈ f9–f12 (cut ≈ f10). Layers carry a hidden 262.5% time-stretch. Fills: #222222 / #26D07C / #FFFFFF.
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: mogrt/ae-template CR_Transition_Bars + ffx of the shape contents

animation_patterns.name: Logo revealed by the bars (alpha matte)
animation_patterns.description: Logo precomp centred at 80–100% scale and ALPHA-matted to the transition precomp, so it exists only where the bars are. It needs no animation of its own: it is wiped in and out with the bars.

animation_patterns.name: Frame drift loop
animation_patterns.description: Notch rectangles drift on LINEAR Vector Position keys at 0 / 4.0 / 7.44 / 9.96 / 11.8 / 14.96 s; Rect 6 x runs -367.9 → -534.5 → -163.6 → -367.9 → -671.9 → -367.9 (first = last). Looped by Time Remap 0→14.96 s with loopOut(). The 1x1 version runs the same keys stretched 149.4% (22.36 s period).
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: expression preset CR_Loop_Drift (valueAtTime(time % period), exact 15.0 s period)

animation_patterns.name: Proximity (lens) scale grid
animation_patterns.description: Grid of 150 px precomp cells; Scale = linear(distance to CTRL null, hitbox Outside 2000, hitbox Inside 0, Scale From 100, Scale To 0), so cells shrink near the focus. Focus null at (1920,1080) with wiggle(0.3,1000). Glyph opacity 25%.

animation_patterns.name: Twinkle grid
animation_patterns.description: '+' tile repeated with CC RepeTile (expand 3200–3780 px), 50% scale, 35% opacity, LUMA-matted to a hidden solid with Fractal Noise (Block, scale 111.7, complexity 1, Evolution time*50; matte opacity 50% or 100%).
animation_patterns.candidate_preset: ffx CR_BG_TwinkleGrid (seamless: Evolution time*360*N/L + Cycle Evolution)

animation_patterns.name: Block-noise dissolve reveal
animation_patterns.description: Target layer LUMA-matted to a hidden solid with Fractal Noise (Noise Type Block, Contrast 400, Brightness -100, Scale 244, Complexity 1). Random Seed steps 0→24 linearly over 191 f @24, about one new block pattern every 8 f, giving a digital dissolve.

animation_patterns.name: Media inside a card window
animation_patterns.description: Footage layer ALPHA-matted to a static card shape (non-adjacent AE 23+ matte). A decorative layer is parented to the card and matted to the same card.
